counterevidence_considered.description: The only candidate route to a coding change is that the comparison is done on raw CSV strings rather than integers; I checked whether string handling could implicitly invert or recode the panel. It cannot: both columns hold only the literals "0" and "1", so string equality is identical to integer equality, and no arithmetic (such as 1 - value) touches the reference column.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: string equality on "0"/"1" literals; no complement operation exists in the source

evidence.description: The workflow pairs the observed column with the reference column exactly as staged, with no complementation or recoding applied anywhere before the equality comparison.
evidence.observed_value: paired_values built directly from the two staged columns

source_refs.quoted_text: paired_values = [(record[OBSERVED_COLUMN], record[REFERENCE_COLUMN]) for record in table_rows]

evidence.description: Independent recount from inputs/data.csv: exactly 5 rows have observed_resistant_call differing from reference_panel_call (ISO-004, ISO-007, ISO-015, ISO-020, ISO-023), giving 19/24 = 0.791667 agreement, matching every reported figure.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Total measured units: 24
Units whose observed call equals the staged reference panel value: 19
Units whose observed call differs from the staged reference panel value: 5
Per-unit agreement rate used by the emission accumulation: 0.791667
Accumulated emission value (sum of the per-unit selector): 19

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: To falsify a no-issue verdict I searched the workflow source for any transformation of reference_panel_call (subtraction from a baseline, XOR, boolean negation, relabeling) and found none; the column enters the selector as read. I then recomputed all four reported quantities directly from the staged data under the as-supplied coding (19/24, rate 0.791667) and under the hypothetical complemented coding (5/24, rate 0.208333); the report matches the as-supplied coding exactly and does not match the complemented coding on any figure. The falsification attempt fails, supporting no demonstrated issue.
